headline: Executive order creates a White House council focused on opportunity and revitalization.
what_it_does: This order sets up a new group inside the federal government called the White House Opportunity and Revitalization Council. No summary was provided, so details about the council's members, duties, and powers are not available here. Based on the title, the council appears meant to coordinate federal work related to economic opportunity and the revitalization of communities.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies may be asked to join or work with the new council, though the specific roles are not described in the available material.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 12, 2018; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
